IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black
hair walks a navy runway in a white knit
long-sleeve polo with black placket trim and
matching white knit shorts with black piping. She
wears black and white lace-up sneakers and black
ankle socks. Her expression is calm and direct.
Soft stage light. Palette of white, black, and deep
navy. Crisp and graphic, in the style of a spring
runway show. This is a near-duplicate of section
